HARD REQUIREMENTS OF THE TRAVELLERS (they override the steps and defaults above). Follow the ones that concern your task, say in "notes" which of those you could not meet, and do not mention the others:
- The travellers drive their own car from Turku to Stockholm and back, and use it at the destination. If the route is by road only, it is roughly 330 km and 4 h of driving each way (estimated from the straight-line distance; not valid for a route over the sea). Nobody searches or plans flights, trains or buses. The ground transport searcher still calls plan_public_transport for both directions, only to see whether the route crosses the sea: if a connection includes a ferry, that ferry is the car ferry (report it as mode "ferry" and look up the fare for a car and its passengers with web_search); if none does, it reports no options. The planner plans the car ferry from the transport summary when there is one; otherwise the plan's transport outbound and return are null with "why": "own car". Day 1 starts with a "transport" item "Arrive in <destination> by car" at a realistic time after the drive, and the last day ends with "Depart by car". The cost has no fuel or charging, tolls or parking (they depend on the car) and no local public transport; the guide's "Getting there and back" says they drive (with the car ferry if there is one, otherwise the road distance and time above) and that those costs are not included.
If a requirement mentions children, infants or pets, pass them to every search tool that has such a parameter.
